subject: Phase 100360: Per-File Coverage Guard for the Lines/Functions Floor
verdict_justification: The per-file coverage guard is cleanly implemented in stdlib Python, fail-closed, and correctly wired into Makefile and CI without duplicate test runs. All acceptance criteria and test scenarios pass. Minor findings include a missing trailing newline in coverage_guard.py, unhandled --help CLI flags, and host config isolation sensitivity.
standard: Phase 100360 Roadmap acceptance criteria (AC-100360-01 through AC-100360-06)
Single instrumented test run constraint across Makefile and CI
Fail-closed behavior on missing or malformed reports
Zero roadmap or phase leaks into production code and comments

findings.title: Missing trailing newline in scripts/coverage_guard.py
findings.evidence: scripts/coverage_guard.py:200 has no trailing newline character (POSIX EOF violation).
findings.recommendation: Add a trailing newline to scripts/coverage_guard.py.
findings.resolution: Added the trailing newline (now byte-checked). Evidence: `python3 -c "open('scripts/coverage_guard.py','rb').read().endswith(b'\n')"` -> True; `git diff` shows only the final line changed with no `No newline at end of file` marker.

findings.title: --help and -h flags treated as report file path rather than showing usage
findings.evidence: Executing `python3 scripts/coverage_guard.py --help` attempts to open `--help` as a file and exits with code 3 (`ReportError: cannot read report --help: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '--help'`).
findings.recommendation: Intercept '-h' and '--help' in `main()` to print usage to stdout and exit 0.
findings.resolution: `main()` now checks `-h`/`--help` before the file-path branch, prints the module usage to stdout, and returns 0 (usage errors still go to stderr with exit 2). Added a `--help` case to `--self-test`. Evidence: `python3 scripts/coverage_guard.py --help` exit 0 and `-h` exit 0 (usage printed); no-args still exit 2; `--self-test` -> `self-test ok: --help (exit 0)` and `self-test: all passed`.

findings.title: Non-hermetic test execution on hosts with existing deployment.json
findings.evidence: When host has ~/.config/am/deployment.json, `make coverage` fails unless AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG is directed to an empty file like /tmp/am-empty-deployment.json; an empty AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG='' causes setup_cli tests to fail due to config directory resolution.
findings.recommendation: Document the empty-file requirement in coverage.md or provide default dummy config fallback during test execution.
findings.resolution: Took both routes the recommendation offers. (1) Makefile: `test`, `coverage`, and `cov` now export `AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG=$(COV_DIR)/no-deployment-overlay.json` (a path that does not exist, so the effective overlay is empty); a command-line `AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG=...` overrides it. (2) coverage.md §7 documents the requirement and states that an empty string is not equivalent (it disables deployment loading and breaks `am setup` tests with `cannot resolve a config directory`). Evidence: before the change `cargo test -p clio reindex_dense_confirmed_without_embedder_exits_3` FAILED on this host (host `~/.config/am/deployment.json` supplies `embed.url` -> actual ExitCode 0, wanted 3); with an isolated path the test exits 3 and passes; after the change `make check` reports `reindex_dense_confirmed_without_embedder_exits_3 ... ok` with 0 FAILED and 0 clippy warnings, and `make coverage` exits 0.

issues.title: Missing trailing newline in scripts/coverage_guard.py
issues.why_it_matters: POSIX standards and standard Git formatting require text files to end with a newline to prevent concatenation defects and diff noise.
issues.impact: Triggers 'No newline at end of file' in git diff and some POSIX linters.
issues.proposed_fix: Add a trailing newline to the end of scripts/coverage_guard.py.

issues.title: Standard help flags (--help, -h) fail closed as unreadable report files
issues.why_it_matters: Developers expecting standard CLI ergonomics who run `python3 scripts/coverage_guard.py --help` see a file read error and exit code 3 instead of usage instructions.
issues.impact: Unintuitive CLI behavior for human operators discovering script options.
issues.evidence: python3 scripts/coverage_guard.py --help -> coverage-guard: error: cannot read report --help: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '--help' (exit 3)
issues.proposed_fix: In main(), check `if '-h' in argv or '--help' in argv:` and print usage then return EXIT_OK.
issues.resolution: Fixed exactly as proposed; see finding F-02 resolution.

issues.title: Host deployment config leakage requires explicit dummy config file for hermetic testing
issues.why_it_matters: A host with an active sidecar in ~/.config/am/deployment.json fails embedder offline tests, and setting AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG='' breaks setup_cli tests.
issues.impact: Local test and coverage runs on developer workstations require AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG pointing to an empty file rather than an empty string.
issues.evidence: setup_cli_fail_tests fail when AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG='' ('cannot resolve a config directory'); embedder tests fail when AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG is unset on host with sidecar.
issues.proposed_fix: Update Makefile or test runner to ensure an isolated empty deployment config is automatically supplied when running make coverage.
issues.resolution: Makefile now supplies an isolated, nonexistent `AM_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG` automatically for `test`/`coverage`/`cov`; see finding F-03 resolution.

dismissed: Failure of per-file guard to execute when cargo llvm-cov aggregate fails: by design, make aborts on first failure and aggregate failure is already a gating condition.
No execution bit on scripts/coverage_guard.py: invoked via python3 in both Makefile and ci.yml, consistent with other scripts in scripts/.
